# zerops_project_env (Resource)

A USER project environment variable. Changes do not restart services. Content is always sensitive in Terraform state. With non-sudo credentials, masked refresh retains known content and cannot detect remote content drift. Importing masked secrets requires sudo credentials.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "zerops_project" "example" {
  name = "example"
}

resource "zerops_project_env" "example" {
  project_id = zerops_project.example.id
  key        = "APPLICATION_MODE"
  content    = "production"
  sensitive  = false
}

# Content is sensitive in Terraform state, regardless of the remote masking flag.
# Changes wait for the environment update but do not restart services.
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `content` (String, Sensitive) Single-line ASCII content, at most 8192 characters. Stored in state even when masked remotely.
- `key` (String) Environment key. SYSTEM isolation keys and reserved prefixes cannot be managed.
- `project_id` (String) Parent project ID.

### Optional

- `sensitive` (Boolean) Mask content in the remote API.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) Operation timeouts. One timeout covers lock acquisition, API requests, queued work and readiness polling. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Canonical environment row ID, not process ID.

<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import zerops_project_env.example '<project_id>/APPLICATION_MODE'
# Alternatively, import the canonical environment row ID (not process ID):
# terraform import zerops_project_env.example '<env_id>'
# Sensitive import requires sudo credentials when content is masked.
```
